stages.finding: Seven-pressure helium-4 neutron-dispersion table preserved with symbolic mappings, observed/missing cells and reproducible provenance
stages.boundary: No inference of new helium phase law, listening perception, or unification

stages.finding: Matched-q interval ordering and sampling invariants over the frozen neutron-dispersion source
stages.boundary: Reported errors are not covariance or calibrated probability distributions

stages.finding: Phonon, maxon and roton feature comparisons retain missingness and mark post-hoc common coverage as exploratory
stages.boundary: Coverage-core roton results are exploratory, not preregistered discovery

stages.finding: Eight published helium-II temperature model inputs mapped with exact mass-fraction closure
stages.boundary: Published model inputs are not independently observed phase labels

stages.finding: Fourteen evaluated SVP reference temperatures span the lambda boundary, preserving zero versus out-of-domain null distinctions
stages.boundary: Reference values are not a new measured discontinuity or independent phase classifier

stages.finding: Twelve published gravity-corrected and averaged Lipa-Chui experimental heat-capacity rows preserved across lambda
stages.boundary: One original processed campaign, no per-row errors or orthogonal phase diagnostics

stages.finding: Four published critical-fit summaries trace four acquisition campaigns across three laboratory families
stages.boundary: Secondary fit uncertainty boxes do not authenticate original measurement rows or new experimental replication

stages.finding: Ten literature records, four campaigns and only one campaign with source-pinned processed measurements
stages.boundary: Zero eligible independently sourced measurement-campaign pairs; no classifier score

stages.finding: Fourteen synthetic provenance/holdout controls reject evidence leakage; prospective protocol remains blocked for actual physics
stages.boundary: Synthetic controls and prospective metadata are not physical training, source-separated accuracy or preregistered old experiments
